line.founding.a-dew-spring-walled-in: A dew spring, walled in behind the rubble. Someone wanted it to themselves.
line.founding.and-if-the-brood-that: And if the brood that ate the Hollow follows us here?
line.founding.aurelith-has-fallen-and-no: Aurelith has fallen, and no Royal Chamber stands to revive her.
line.founding.behind-the-water-someone-h: Behind the water... someone hid this here, and sealed it in amber.
line.founding.caplings-let-the-young-war: Caplings. Let the young warriors learn their work on something that bites back gently.
line.founding.gladly-and-you-have-a: Gladly. And you have a spring at your door, raw and bright. Siphon it, carefully, and I can begin.
line.founding.here-we-start-again-and: Here. We start again, and we start clean.
line.founding.hornets-leave-them-be-unti: Hornets. Leave them be until we're stronger, or until we need what they hoard.
line.founding.i-had-your-letter-i: I had your letter. I've studied substance all my life. I know what it did to Ashka's brood.
line.founding.look-at-it-shine-raw: Look at it shine. Raw, and so patient. A Siphon on it, Majesty, and I'll keep it in hand.
line.founding.look-at-the-pool-they: Look at the pool they drink from. That glow is what took Ashka's brood.
line.founding.majesty-hold-your-stings-i: Majesty! Hold your stings. It's only me, and my stills.
line.founding.movement-on-the-ridge-and: Movement on the ridge, and across the ravine. They've smelled the new Nest. To arms!
line.founding.my-queen-the-glade-just: My Queen, the glade! Just as the scouts said.
line.founding.not-by-ants-not-yet: Not by ants. Not yet. But in the east there are beetles who keep it in glass, and are not changed at all.
line.founding.one-root-across-the-ravine: One root across the ravine, and their den on the far side. Whoever holds this root holds the west.
line.founding.salves-flasks-wraps-for-co: Salves! Flasks! Wraps for cold mornings! Amber only, Majesty. I'm a simple bug.
line.founding.sap-from-an-old-root: Sap from an old root, warm as a brood chamber. Bring the wounded here.
line.founding.substance-welling-up-raw-a: Substance, welling up raw at our door. We leave it be. For now.
line.founding.the-burrows-are-broken-the: The burrows are broken. The glade is ours.
line.founding.the-colony-stands-now-we: The colony stands. Now we take the fight to them: the burrows on the ridge, and the den across the ravine.
line.founding.the-den-is-empty-nothing: The den is empty. Nothing must nest there again.
line.founding.the-ridge-burrows-are-brok: The ridge burrows are broken. Nothing more hatches there.
line.founding.the-roots-here-are-awake: The roots here are awake. They guard that amber like their own sap.
line.founding.their-burrows-this-is-wher: Their burrows. This is where the waves hatch. Break them, and the glade is ours.
line.founding.then-tell-me-it-can: Then tell me it can be held without it changing us.
line.founding.then-the-beetles-are-next: Then the beetles are next, Majesty. Their glass is waiting.
line.founding.then-they-find-us-ready: Then they find us ready. Workers, to the amber. Raise a Brood Mound and a Soldier Burrow.
line.founding.then-we-will-learn-their: Then we will learn their glass. Stay with us, Oleander.
line.founding.there-drawn-not-drunk-that: There. Drawn, not drunk. That is the whole difference, Majesty, and it is everything.
line.founding.toads-mind-their-tongues-a: Toads. Mind their tongues, and keep the workers clear until they're gone.
objective.founding.burrows.description: Destroy the feral burrows on the north-east ridge and in the den across the ravine.
objective.founding.burrows.title: Destroy the feral burrows
objective.founding.colony.description: Raise a Brood Mound and a Soldier Burrow in the glade.
objective.founding.colony.title: Build the colony
objective.founding.spring.description: Build a Substance Siphon on the spring at the glade's east edge.
objective.founding.spring.title: The substance spring
